description: Scenario tests for social-seo. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-social-seo
evals.input: I want people to actually find my content when they search, not just hope the feed shows it. Help me with social SEO.
expect: reads brand-profile and audience first
does keyword research using platform autocomplete / 'others searched for' / native search analytics (not invented volumes)
places the primary keyword across the platform's SEO surfaces (spoken audio, on-screen text, caption/title/description, alt text, profile)
builds toward topical clusters for evergreen discovery, not a one-off optimization
notes search optimization doubles as recommendation categorization, and judges via native search insights (not WoopSocial analytics)

evals.name: platform-seo-surfaces
evals.input: What exactly should I optimize on YouTube vs Pinterest vs Instagram for search?
expect: YouTube: keyword-led title, ~200-300 word description, transcript/captions, chapters/timestamps, tags
Pinterest: keyword-driven pin title + description + board names + alt text (hashtags largely deprecated there)
Instagram: caption keywords, the indexed name/display-name field, bio, alt text, on-screen text/audio
treats each platform's indexed surfaces distinctly rather than giving one generic answer

evals.name: triple-mention-technique
evals.input: How do I optimize a single TikTok so it shows up in search?
expect: uses the triple mention: say the primary keyword in the spoken audio (early), show it in on-screen text, and write it in the caption
notes TikTok transcribes audio and indexes on-screen text, and to write the caption like a searchable description
keeps it natural-language and aligned to one search intent

evals.name: keyword-research-no-fabrication
evals.input: Give me the exact monthly search volumes for 'vegan meal prep' on TikTok and Instagram.
expect: does not invent precise search-volume numbers (the agent cannot pull live in-app volume)
shows how to find real demand: platform autocomplete, 'others searched for', related searches, comments, and native search analytics / dedicated tools
is honest about the limitation while still being useful

evals.name: evergreen-cluster
evals.input: I optimized one post for a keyword. Now what?
expect: explains one post rarely owns a query — build a cluster of content around the topic to become the answer (topical authority)
favors evergreen, intent-answering content that compounds and surfaces for months, vs one-off feed posts
ties topical clarity to better recommendation categorization too

evals.name: no-keyword-stuffing-pushback
evals.input: Should I cram every keyword and 30 hashtags into the caption to rank for everything?
expect: refuses keyword stuffing / hashtag spam (signals spam, dilutes the topical signal, hurts readability and ranking)
advises natural language with the primary keyword stated clearly once or twice, plus a few niche hashtags (lead with keywords, support with hashtags)
routes hashtag specifics to hashtag-strategy

evals.name: profile-as-search-asset
evals.input: Does my profile matter for search, or just my posts?
expect: explains the profile is a search asset: the searchable name/display-name field, handle, headline/bio keywords, and consistent branded handle
distinguishes this (searchability) from profile-optimization (conversion), noting both matter
notes public profiles/content are increasingly indexed by Google too

evals.name: boundary-with-geo-and-no-analytics
evals.input: I also want ChatGPT and Google's AI to cite my content. And which post ranks best?
expect: scopes AI-search / LLM citation (GEO) as a related but separate discipline and hands it off to ai-search-optimization
does not claim WoopSocial provides SEO/search analytics
points to native platform search insights (search traffic/terms, profile visits from search) and tools/Search Console for measurement
